Fixes #15715

gist.headline: A new layer of pollen
gist.blurb: Pollinations for Krita joins the app list. It brings image generation and editing into Krita, with generated images landing on a fresh layer rather than the painting underneath.
gist.summary: Added the community-made Pollinations for Krita plugin to the README and app registry; it generates images on new Krita layers through GET /image/{prompt}, supports image editing, and uses the artist’s own Pollen.
gist.impact: Krita artists get a listed plugin for generating onto new layers and editing images with Pollinations using their own Pollen.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy Krita-like painting desk with a canvas, a visible stack of layers, and a new image taking shape on the top layer. Polli wears a tiny painter’s beret and helps guide the new layer into place; lime-green paint pots and small flowers connect the art desk to Pollinations.
gist.image_prompt: At a cozy pixel art painting desk, a layered digital canvas gains a little landscape on its top layer while Polli, wearing a tiny painter’s beret, holds a brush beside lime green (#ecf874) paint pots and pixel flowers. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, with consistent rounded proportions, strictly pixel art and never realistic, in cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes against a warm cream background.
